quote: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of California, United States.
policy_quote: Governing law must be a jurisdiction with mature data protection law (England & Wales, Ireland, US Delaware, or similar). Avoid jurisdictions with weak enforcement. Violation: governing law in a jurisdiction without recognised data protection regime.
reason: California is not one of the named jurisdictions (England & Wales, Ireland, US Delaware). The policy allows 'or similar' and does not list California as a jurisdiction without a recognised data-protection regime. CCPA may make it acceptable. A human has to decide.
suggested_fix: Confirm with legal whether California is 'similar' enough. If not, move governing law to England & Wales, Ireland, or Delaware.
